verdict.rationale: B and D both explicitly satisfy the refundable-room, desk, and short-access requirements. D is cheaper, much closer on foot, and has the highest preferred-match score; B has a higher public rating plus breakfast and a fridge. Neither set of advantages clearly dominates without a stated priority among convenience, rating, amenities, price, and the portal score. A is not a short walk or short rideshare, and C does not explicitly list a desk.
